title: fix(desktop): no pink border on the camera bubble in recordings (NIW2-588)
body:
Linear: [NIW2-588](https://linear.app/niway/issue/NIW2-588/camera-bubble-no-pink-border-in-recordings-chrome-only-on-hover)

## Why

Recordings with the camera on show a pink ring around the webcam circle.

## Where the border came from

- **Live bubble window (the cause).** `.bubble` in `camera-bubble.module.css` had a permanent `border: 3px solid var(--accent-primary)`. The bubble is a floating window that sits on the recorded screen, so the screen capture recorded the ring in every take.
- **Editor / export (not a cause).** On `main` the editor and export never composite a webcam (the webcam track is not merged yet), so nothing there draws a border. The editor's `camera-box` is the zoom camera, unrelated.
- **Hover chrome (a smaller leak).** The outline, size label, grip and close button were hidden only once the take became `active`. That broadcast reaches the bubble window *after* the capture has started, so a pointer resting on the bubble could leave the chrome in the first frames.

## What changed

- The bubble has no border at rest. The accent outline exists only under the hover-chrome selector.
- The chrome hides as soon as a take is **pending** (countdown or streams acquiring), not only once it is active. A grip drag in progress ends at that point too and saves the size it reached. A cancelled countdown gives the chrome back.
- Tests: a component test for the pending state, and a stylesheet test that reads the real CSS (jsdom applies none) and fails if `.bubble` gets a `border` or `outline` again.

`bun run verify` passes locally. No runtime check was done on this machine; that is the QA below.

## How to test it yourself

1. Rebuild/run the desktop app from this branch and turn the camera on.
2. With the pointer away from the bubble: the webcam shows with **no pink ring**, only the soft shadow.
3. Hover the bubble: the pink outline, size label (`240 px · M`), resize grip and close (X) button appear. Move the pointer away: all of them disappear.
4. Leave the pointer resting on the bubble and start a recording with the countdown on. When the countdown appears, the outline, label, grip and X disappear at once, even though the pointer is still on the bubble.
5. Cancel a countdown with the pointer still on the bubble: the chrome comes back.
6. Record a few seconds, stop, and open the recording: the webcam circle has no coloured outline in any frame, including the first.
7. Repeat steps 2 and 6 with the rounded-square shape.
